XENO TRACK // FIELD MANUAL

QUICK START

  • Drag to move, pinch to zoom, twist to rotate, two fingers up/down to tilt.
  • LOC locks onto you. SEARCH finds roads and places and makes routes.
  • Hold a finger on the map to drop a pin.
  • Open the app online once, then it works with no signal in areas you have saved.

MAP

  • North arrow (top right): tap to face north and flatten. Crosshair: reset view, street level, centred on you.
  • VIEW button: BLD = 3D wireframe buildings (zoom in past 15). TER = contour lines with heights, plus 3D relief when tilted. OFF = plain lines.
  • Compass (top left): map turns to the way you face. Off = north-up, arrow shows the way you move.
  • Hide button (top right): hides the controls for a clean map. A LOC button stays beside it to lock back on.
  • © OSM · INFO (bottom left): zoom, coordinates, tiles stored and errors.

SPEED BOX

  • Your speed. Tap the number for KM/H or MPH: the limit sign, margin, alerts, voice, distances and wind all switch with it. Drag the box; drag its corner or pinch to resize.
  • Shows straight-line distance to the highlighted street or your last pin.

BOTTOM BUTTONS

  • COLR: next colour scheme: wireframe (night and day), then four standard map looks with ground, parks, water and white roads (Standard and City, day and night).
  • LOC: fly to you and follow.
  • NAME: street names on every road, for paper-map use.
  • SAVE: saves the area around the screen centre for offline use. Radius is the next button (10 to 200 km). Big saves ask for a second tap. If one stops, press Save again: stored tiles are skipped.
  • SPEAKER: mutes and unmutes everything. What you hear when unmuted is chosen in the Sound tab.
  • CLR: tap removes the highlight or newest pin. Hold clears everything.

SEARCH AND ROUTES

  • Search roads and places. Saved areas search by name with no signal. Tap a result to light up the whole road.
  • ROUTE on a result, or Route to pin, draws a route. Online first, otherwise built from your saved map.
  • Route bar: next turn, distance, minutes left, ETA. Cancel removes it. It survives restarts.
  • Voice: "In 500 metres, turn left…", then 200 m and "now". Says "off route" and "arrived".
  • Smart re-route: only after several clues agree, never on one bad GPS fix.
  • Long offline trips (to about 380 km): make the route online, then Save route (25 km width is best).
  • Route via pins: pins 1, 2, 3… are visited in order.

PINS AND BEEP

  • Up to 100 pins, numbered and joined by a dashed trail. They are kept between sessions.
  • Proximity beep follows the closer of the highlighted street or last pin. Silent beyond 5 km, faster as you close in, every 0.2 s inside 100 m.

RIDING WARNINGS

  • Bends (needs a route): two-note chime then e.g. "Sharp left, 45", the speed to ride it at. Words: easy, bend, sharp, hairpin. It only speaks if you are going too fast.
  • Pace (Alerts tab): off, relaxed, normal or brisk.
  • Grades: three rising notes for a climb, three falling for a descent, then e.g. "Steep descent". Words: shallow, moderate, steep, very steep, dangerous. Heights are about 30 m resolution.
  • Speed limit circle (bottom right, drag it anywhere): the posted limit for the road you are on, from OpenStreetMap. Grey "--" means no limit is recorded there. Over the limit plus the margin: buzzer, then "Overspeed" (repeats every 15 s, flashes red). Bend speeds never go above the limit.
  • Order: overspeed first, then bends, turn calls, grades. A higher one interrupts; others wait, and are dropped if you have passed them.
  • Voice speed (Sound tab): normal, quick or fastest.

OFFLINE AND SAVED MAPS

  • Map: saved only (View tab, on by default): never downloads tiles for the view, so the map is instant. Unsaved ground shows a rough stand-in. Switch to online + saved to fetch new ground.
  • First run saves 10 km around home and the world at low zoom. Save adds more. Terrain heights are saved with it.
  • Saves also keep the speed limits for the area (up to about 150 blocks of 4 x 5 km), so the circle works with no signal.
  • Save at arrow / pin / all pins / route: in the Save tab. Save a distant town by dropping a pin there first.

WEATHER

  • The scrolling ticker updates every 10 minutes. Tap it for the full page: now, tiles, next 12 hours, 3 days. Offline shows the last forecast.

SEARCH PANEL TABS

  • SEARCH: find roads and places, Clear highlight, Route via pins, To last pin, Sim drive, Routing (auto or offline only).
  • PINS: type a name, pick a map pin and press Save pin to list. Tap a saved pin, then Copy lat, long, Navigate (puts it on the map as the newest pin and routes to it) or Delete.
  • ALERTS: Bend warnings (pace and test), Grade alerts (level, unit, test), Speed limit (on/off, margin, test overspeed), Road hazards (speed bumps, traffic calming, level crossings, speed cameras, cattle grids: on/off and test). Each hazard type has its own sound.
  • VIEW: View (buildings, terrain, off), Icon (your arrow, coloured arrows, or a bike, car, SUV, ute, hiker, prospector or explorer: pick it on the sample route; Follow theme resets it), Map saved only or online + saved, Xenomorph (on/off, walk now).
  • SOUND: Voice, Tracker ping, Alerts and Turn directions each on or off. Speed, Corner and Hill each tone + voice, tone only, voice only or off. Then the voice list, test and voice speed.
  • SAVE: Save at arrow, Save route (with width), Save at pin, Save all pins.
  • HELP: this Manual, and the Debug page (logs and self-test; Copy all to send to Claude).

SIM DRIVE (test without moving)

  • Fake position drives your route (or pins). Buttons: Pause, x1 to x60, km/h (fake speed, 20 to 120, to test warnings), Skip (just before the next turn), Stop.

IF SOMETHING LOOKS WRONG

  • Black or sparse map: that ground is not saved. Turn on online + saved, or Save the area.
  • No sound: check the speaker icon and tap the screen once.
  • No warnings: bends need a route; grades need GPS and movement. Check the Alerts tab.
  • Anything else: Help tab, Debug page, Copy all, send to Claude.
